desc:
The most comfortable relationships between people often involve keeping things superficial—and Ren Jinhuan’s social principles are no exception. He puts on a facade of gentleness and kindness in public, but behind the scenes, he is entirely calculating and opportunistic. With his boss’s downfall, he urgently needs to board a new “big ship.”

People are always debating the merits of red versus white roses. While fresh flowers are certainly beautiful, they’ll eventually wither. Ren Jinhuan, however, loves only golden roses. But the golden rose he has set his sights on—Jin Xiangtang—has no intention of entering his “fish pond,” and their first meeting ended in a “shipwreck.”

...

“Office social butterfly” – “Master tea artist” – “Everyone is just a pawn” – “Fishing-style” shou

“The romantic ‘reverse-fishing’ king” – “Master tea connoisseur” – “I refuse to enter your fishpond” – “Tsundere” gong
title: Adding Gold to Brocade
